name: omni-desktop-profile
description: The dsh profile the Automagik desktop app starts: dsh's own base and web app, its plugin market, Automagik's plugins (the Bot team, the welcome and ACP agents: Claude Code and Codex through the person's own CLIs, from this repository) and Omni's (channels and canvases, from the Omni release omni.json pins), and dsh-subscriptions, the add-on that signs in to the plans DSH doesn't, from a reviewed fork at a pinned commit. Claude comes through DSH's own pi-ai route: a Claude Pro or Max sign-in, or an Anthropic API key.
